name: frontier-fast-challenge
frozenTracksNote: Listed in `tracks` so the id validates, but do NOT submit: these are frozen and no submission can be verified. qwen3.6-35b-a3b-nvfp4-gb10-v1 is frozen because Qwen3.6 uses the GDN attention backend, which rejects VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1, so greedy output is non-deterministic and the correctness gate can never pass.

scoring.acceptanceBandAppliesTo: baseline phase vs pinned calibration (box health), not the candidate

boards.kernel: New and faster kernels, engine and build changes. This is what a track's headline record, chart, recipe, social card and bandwidth ceiling report.
boards.speculative: Speculative decoding: n-gram/prompt-lookup, a draft model, or multi-token-prediction heads. Ranked and published on its own board.
boards.why: Exact verification emits the identical greedy sequence, so speculation passes the correctness gate by construction and wins on almost any model. Ranking it beside a kernel result would make one board answer two questions.
classifiedFrom: Sources/runner/serving.json `speculative` block — decides on its own
patch series wiring up speculation: TWO independent markers required from common_speculative, n_draft, ngram_cache, prompt_lookup, spec_decode
boards.advice: Do not enable speculation in the same submission as kernel work — send it separately and both results stand.
boards.notAMarker: `mtp` — Qwen3.6 ships multi-token-prediction heads as part of its architecture, so a kernel patch compiling near that code is not a speculative submission

longContext.reportedAs: longContext on each verified record: decode, prefill, ttft, their paired speedups, and a score using the same formula
longContext.why: At 512 tokens decode is weight-bandwidth bound; at 16k it is dominated by attention over the KV cache, so a kernel can win one and be neutral at the other.
longContext.notMeasuredOn: vLLM tracks — the pinned engine is --max-model-len 8192 and the dedicated boot a 16k window needs costs GPU memory the largest track does not have; those runs record the reason.
